system.description: Sway over an area of mortal society (Bureaucracy, Church, Finance, High Society, Industry, Legal, Media, Occult, Police, Political, Street, Transportation, Underworld, or University). Traits are allocated separately to each area of Influence, and your total Influence cannot exceed the sum of your permanent Physical, Social, and Mental Traits. Spending temporary Influence Traits equal to the cost listed for an effect in a given area lets you perform that effect; each city has a finite pool of each Influence type available to be claimed.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
